limitations: Original 36 completed / 12 timeout matrix remains unchanged. Newly completed cells have no original timing to divide by.
Profiles are instrumented attribution, not uninstrumented speedup. Paired medians describe one local fixed workload; seed restarts do not create independent statistical trials.
RSS is whole-process high water including imports, warmups and SDK scratch; paired RSS additionally includes diagnostics. Visible tensors are not total peak.
No A800, GPU, multi-card capacity, threshold, distance trend or release performance claim.
Local default verification encountered ENOSPC while writing captures. Raw log retained; its five failures and five errors are not classified as all baseline or passing. Full remote CI is required.

protocol.stop: record all failures/timeouts; do not change workload or append samples
